description: This file contains utility functions for memory management and resource cleanup in a telemetry component related to event markers, parameters, and grep markers, as well as a device property retrieval function.

methods.name: void freeParam(void * data)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a Param structure and its string members.

methods.name: void freeStaticParam(void * data)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a StaticParam structure and its string members.

methods.name: void freeEMarker(void * data)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an EventMarker, including conditional freeing of its members based on type.

methods.name: void freeAccumulatedParam(void * data)
methods.description: Frees a string allocated for accumulated parameters.

methods.name: void freeGMarker(void * data)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a GrepMarker, including its string members.

methods.name: int compareLogFileNames(const void * g1,const void * g2)
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting GrepMarkers by logFile name.

methods.name: void freeTriggerCondition(void * data)
methods.description: Frees memory for a TriggerCondition structure and its members.

methods.name: bool getDevicePropertyData(const char * dev_prop_name,char * out_data,unsigned int buff_size)
methods.description: Reads a device property value from a file and outputs it into a buffer.

ctags.name: getDevicePropertyData
ctags.pattern: /^bool getDevicePropertyData(const char *dev_prop_name, char *out_data, unsigned int buff_size)$/
